            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3773">slob dpon chos kyi grags pa</rs>s mdzad pa'i <rs type="work" ref="db:3774" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">tshad ma rnaM par nges pa</rs> 'di la don bzhï <note type="gloss"><expan>gsum</expan></note> ste | bstan bcos rtsom pa'i rgyu dang | rang gi bstan bcos kyi 'bras bu dgos 'brel <note type="gloss"><expan>gnyis</expan> kyis bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa</note> dang | bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin dang | bstan bcos kyi don nges pas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3771"><rs type="work" ref="db:3770" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">mdo</rs> mdzad pa</rs>'i <choice><sic>dgos</sic><corr>dgongs</corr> </choice> pa nges pa la spro ba bskyed pa'o |</seg></TEI>
